title: [macOS arm64][Compatibility/Metal] godot-dev aborts during GLES3 renderer teardown after successful SubViewport capture
body:
### Tested versions

4.7.1.rc.custom_build.f95aba4bb (2026-08-04)

### System information

macOS arm64, Apple M5. Compatibility renderer. OpenGL API 4.1 Metal - 90.5.

### Issue description

A real OpenGL capture completes and writes all requested PNG files. During process shutdown, the editor build emits:

```text
UNSUPPORTED (log once): gldCopyBufferSubData: NEEDS IMPLEMENTATION
ERROR: Pages in use exist at exit in PagedAllocator: N20RasterizerSceneGLES323GeometryInstanceSurfaceE
ERROR: Pages in use exist at exit in PagedAllocator: N20RasterizerSceneGLES321GeometryInstanceGLES3E
ERROR: FATAL: DEV_ASSERT failed "_first == nullptr" is false.
at: ~List (./core/templates/self_list.h:135)
Abort trap: 6
```

The crash happens after the capture result is printed and the PNG files are saved. The process exits with signal 5/abort and reports leaked GLES3 meshes, materials, textures, shaders, and renderer instances. Expected behavior: clean exit after the PNG is written, without renderer allocator assertions or leaked resources.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Run one non-headless Compatibility renderer process that loads a scene with GLB meshes/materials.
2. Create a SubViewport and copy the active camera transform into it.
3. Save a SubViewport texture with get_image().save_png().
4. Call get_tree().quit() immediately after the save.

The capture succeeds; the abort happens during renderer teardown. This was reproduced through a project-side capture driver and has not yet been reduced to a standalone Godot-only project.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

N/A for now: the issue was reproduced in a project-side capture driver; a standalone MRP has not yet been prepared.
